h: ComfyUI 的工作流程利用多代关键帧之间的图像混合来创建扩展的变形序列。主要可以进行 Img2Vid，并且通过适当处理的关键帧（即背景相同或非常相似）可以很好地处理变形字符。

o.en: Workflow for ComfyUI that utilizes image blending between multiple generations of Keyframes to create extended morphing sequences. Can do Img2Vid primarily, and with appropriately processed keyframes (i.e. background identical or very similar) handles morphing characters very well.
